marks.gloss_en: מאי טעמא? דחביב עלי כגופאי, ואין אדם רואה חובה לעצמו
Rava: may [reward] come to me, for when a young scholar comes before me for judgment, I do not lay my head on the pillow until I have sought out his merit
דתנא דבי רבי ישמעאל: בגדים שבישל בהן קדירה לרבו אל ימזוג בהן כוס לרבו -- the stam's ground for Rav Anan's smock
R' Abba would buy meat for thirteen istira from thirteen butchers and hand it over at the door, saying: hurry, hurry
שנאמר עשר תעשר -- עשר בשביל שתתעשר
Rabbi to R' Yishmael son of R' Yosei: the rich of Eretz Yisrael -- in what do they merit [it]?
דאמר רבי חייא בר אבא: the householder of Laodicea, whose wealth came of setting the finest animal aside for Shabbat
and those of other lands? because they honour Shabbat
R' Chanina would wrap himself and stand at dusk on Shabbat eve and say: come, let us go out to greet Shabbat the queen
Rav Safra would singe the [animal's] head
the Chaldeans to the rich gentile: all your property -- Yosef who honours Shabbat will consume it
the Emperor to R' Yehoshua ben Chananya: why does the Shabbat dish smell so fragrant?

the Exilarch asks Rav Hamnuna the meaning of 'and the holy one of the Lord honoured' (Is 58:13); he answers: this is Yom Kippur, which has neither eating nor drinking -- the Torah said: honour it with clean clothing
